sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: 📂 Load configuration no longer wipes your hand-edited lookup tables. Importing a configuration file silently discarded every row you had entered in Default Hidden Columns, the three Relationships icon tables (relation type / other database / streaming service) and the Unicode Character Picker catalogue — the five settings that take the longest to re-enter — and refilled them with the built-in defaults. The summary dialog counted them as applied, so nothing indicated anything had been lost until you noticed your rows were gone.

The cause: those five settings are stored as tables of rows, and the importer ran every value through a text conversion, turning a table into a single comma-joined string. Anything that is not a real table is now rejected and reported as invalid instead of being written, so a damaged or hand-edited file can no longer overwrite good rows with nonsense.

💾 Save configuration now exports your lookup tables as they are RIGHT NOW, not as they were when the page loaded. Editing a table (say adding a symbol to the Unicode picker) and pressing 💾 Save in the table editor stores it immediately, but the rest of the settings are only re-read on a page load — so a configuration file saved in that same session silently contained the rows from before your edit, and loading that file back put the old rows in place again. Adding a symbol, saving a configuration and loading it back therefore lost the symbol. If you have a configuration file saved from before this version and it is missing a recent table edit, re-save it.

💾 Save configuration no longer exports an internal entry (the 🔧 Edit Pinned Filter List button) that was never a setting, and the importer skips it in files saved by earlier versions. It used to write that entry's internal function name into your stored settings as though you had chosen it.
A table you have never edited is now left out of the saved file altogether rather than recorded as empty, so importing it cannot suppress the built-in rows you would otherwise get.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: `ShowAllEntityData_HELP.txt`: new SAVE / LOAD CONFIGURATION section, next to Settings dialog safety guards. The feature has shipped since 9.99.273 and had never been documented. It states what the saved file contains, what it deliberately does NOT contain (per-page-type column visibility, the pinned filter list, filter history, dialog geometry and sizes, the 📊 dropdown's collapsed sections, library preferences), and that importing reloads the page.

The same section records where the two buttons appear: they exist only when Settings is opened via the ⚙️ button, Ctrl+, or the prefix key followed by ",". Opened from the Tampermonkey menu or the MusicBrainz "Editing" menu, you get the shared library's own dialog, without 💾/📂 and with 🔧 Edit Pinned Filter List inert.

The configuration-file format comment in the source claimed the export held only settings that differ from their defaults. It never did, and a full dump is what makes a saved file diffable against another one — corrected to say so.
